items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And they were doing it with [unintelligible] Randolph a trumpet player that was around Chicago.

ctx.x: And he saw us. We were always in the way. And Bud Johnson came in and those guys, but I was still on that violin thing. And [unintelligible] Brown had his saxophone and Bud Johnson had come in from Texas with a tenor. And the next thing I knew they were playing with Louis Armstrong, a bunch of wonderful brothers named Oldham brothers. One played bass horn and one played saxophone. And they were doing it with [unintelligible] Randolph a trumpet player that was around Chicago. And that era, I was still hanging with…
Wait a minute now. I missed something here. Did you… Basie is after Cab Calloway? You worked with Basie after Cab Calloway?
